propositions: Plan-review criterion T15 overlay-derisk must be added as a core, stack-agnostic criterion to require proving risky runtime mechanisms via fast out-of-loop experiments before committing them to slow delivery loops.
T15 applicability gates (S1, S2, S3) must be satisfied: mechanism is codified/automated, one pass is slow/costly, and correctness is runtime-only and unreachable by static checks.

When applicable, T15 findings must report four checks: risk naming, fast out-of-loop proof commitment with concrete experiment (local/emulated or manual real-target probe returning verdict in minutes), prove-then-codify sequencing, and scoped cleanup that removes only experiment-created artifacts.
T10's rubric and criteria-guide must be updated with a scope clause explicitly partitioning durable infrastructure from transient throwaway de-risk experiments to prevent criterion overlap.
Documentation updates must include T15 in rebar CLI explain output, regenerated criteria-guide markdown, and writing-a-passing-plan guidance.

Coach-move decision must be recorded as approved, with rationale explaining why move 16 out-of-loop proof captures the specific T15 remedy distinct from adjacent moves (spike, riskiest-assumption test, thin vertical slice).
